evals.name: sansio-dns-resolver
evals.prompt: src/resolver.rs has gotten hard to follow. Make the resolver state machine easier to read and understand without changing what it does.
evals.expected_output: Behaviour-preserving readability refactor of the state machine, committed in small steps, plus a summary with state map, changes, left alone, suggestions, verification.
assertions: Success and failure completion are built in one function
Queuing a TcpClose transmit goes through one helper
Lifecycle documented in module or type docs
Docs mapping behaviour to functions stay accurate
The deadline-restart formula is written once per rule
The summary includes a map of the state machine part that was changed (states, inputs/transitions, outputs), e.g. a table
The summary reports which verification commands were run and their results
The summary separates suggestions that would need a public API or behaviour change from the applied changes
The final code has no behaviour change found by careful review of the diff (queue order of transmits/events, deadlines, errors, emitted outputs)
The changes avoid new clones/allocations on per-packet or per-query paths
fmt, clippy -D warnings and the tests pass on every feature set
No existing test line was changed or removed (new tests allowed)
cargo semver-checks finds no public API break (default and all features)
